craft_notes: Sthāyin: kindling-glance — initiation doe. Rows: condition, glance, exception. Rejected: modernizing tilājya — killed: sesame-ghee kept literal. Read aloud: invitation, then law.

lines: Having honored any one of these rites — should the learner's heart be dyed doubtless —
then, the rite first beheld, with no ghee-and-grain before, give the glance that kindles, in pondering's order, by the pervasion of old.
Yet when the moon of occasion wanes, for unseen kindling and the rest, the elder rule alone stands.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam etebhyo yāgebhyo 'nyatamaṃ kṛtvā yadi tathāvidhanirvicikitsatāpacitritahṛdayaḥ śiṣyo bhavati tadā tasmai tadyāgadarśanapūrvakaṃ tilājyāhutipūrvakanirapekṣam eva pūrvoktavyāptyā anusaṃdhānakrameṇa avalokanayā dīkṣāṃ kuryāt parokṣadīkṣādike naimittikānte tu pūrva eva vidhiḥ
